data.heading: Week 1 (13 March - 19 March 2026):
data.text: -  Maximum temperatures are likely to be above normal over most parts of the country except, Madhya  Pradesh,  interior  Maharashtra,  interior-Karnatak,  Telangana,  Rayalaseema,  and Kerala; where they are below normal by 2-3°C during the week.

data.heading: Week 2 (20 March - 26 March 2026):
data.text:
-  Maximum  temperatures  are  likely  to  be  above  normal  over  J&K,  Himachal  Pradesh, Uttarakhand,  Arunachal  Pradesh,  Odisha,  some  parts  of  East  M.P.,  Chhattisgarh,  Tamil Nadu, CAP, Coastal Karnataka, Konkan-Goa and Gujarat.
-  No Heat Wave conditions are likely during week 2. However, above-normal to appreciably above-normal maximum temperatures are likely over the western Himalayan region.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Rice: About 21.80 lakh ha area coverage under Summer Rice has been reported as compared to 23.45 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Pulses: About 1.15 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 1.03 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Oilseeds: About  1.69  lakh  ha  area  coverage  has  been  reported  compared  to  1.26  lakh  ha during the corresponding period of last year.
